notes.title: 2021.08.25 updates
notes.content:
1. add  the map transformation game-play,  use elite monsters,rare and above  equipment,level 3 and above souls to transform map grid, get different effects feedback.

2.  Remove element randomization and  exploration events.

3. Added beginner's task, new file can complete beginner's task to obtain rewards.

4. Titles have been added to the manual. You can view the titles  which the hero  won in the squad page. Each title you won can increases your reputation or attributes.

5. Each battle has been changed to random loot drops, selection rewards have been removed, and a combat statistics interface has been added after battles.

6. After each lap, you can choose to open the chest at the finish line and choose 1 out of 4 rewards.

7. Equipment and Souls add the button  " take off all" in squad page  .

8.  Add   different number of resume items for different difficulty levels when a new adventure begin.

9. Fix other known bugs.

notes.title: 2021.6.28 updates
notes.content:
Combat speed and map exploration speed are set separately.

Fixed some popover bugs.

Fixed bug where heroes disappeared after resurrection.

notes.title: 2021.6.24 updates
notes.content:
1. Add automatic Settings panel. You can select rewards automatically, select random events automatically, use drugs and items automatically, etc. High degree of freedom with customizable hangup options.

2. Modified the mode to complete the game for 9 generations. After finishing the game, you can choose a handful of artefact with skills according to the score (the score is determined by the base difficulty, retreat number, defeat number, rune activation number and class activation number). When you complete the level, you will open a new circle. The class and rune data of the new circle will be cleared, and legacy items, soul powers and gold coins will be retained.

3. Each vocation increases base stats and growth rates.

4. When the game starts, a team of powerful heroes will be randomly generated to take care of new players.

5. Optimize some beginners' guidance.

6. After capturing a pet, the soul of the pet will be retained, but it cannot be replaced or removed. Pet Soul is now automatically cast during combat.

7. Fixed the bug that heritage attribute points would be cleared.

8. Other known bugs.

9.uploaded a new English translation.If you have any comments on this translation, please feel free to post them in the forum

notes.title: 2021.5.31 updates
notes.content:
1. Optimize the main city interface.

2. Optimize your daily exploration map.

3. Optimize the combat interface.

4. Modify the reputation inheritance logic. Reputation costs 1200 to keep forever for the next day. Spending 800 reputation can exchange 40 master attributes for 1 next generation attribute. Remaining reputation can be converted to the initial experience for the next generation.

5. Modify the retreat logic. In order to avoid repeated boring refresh level, after retreat will refresh the hero, can only choose to retain 1 piece of equipment and battle soul. Reputation can be redeemable for permanent attribute points and initial experience for reopening a game.

6. Rune of Immolation in the Main City can travel back to the previous generation if the challenge is not successful on the current difficulty. All heirlooms will be retained after travel through.

7. After randomizing 3 element attributes on the main interface, an exploration progress bar will be added. When the exploration value is full, random events can be triggered.

8. Adjusted the crit damage formula so that 15% of the additional skill after a critical hit is crit damage.

9. Adjusted class skills for Elves (Priests, Poets), Orcs (Berserkers), Protoss (Dark Angels), and Undead (Witch, Fighter, Spellcaster).

10. Adjusted the transfer logic so that every recruited class can be permanently transferred before starting the adventure in the main city. Permanently changing jobs requires consumption of Hero Medals. Transferring to the highest level (elemental blessing) will cost the soul of the corresponding class.

11. Added equipment injection function in the main city to inject unwanted hereditary equipment attributes into another hereditary equipment. The injected attribute is a random one in the device attribute pool.

12. Change the help interface to map function. Can view all monsters, equipment, suits, war soul information.

13. Increase the types and rewards of rewards missions.

14. Attribute points inherited by the Grand Master can be assigned at any time in the character interface.

15. Random prompts will pop up on the main interface during exploration, which can be permanently closed in the options interface.

16. Started selection screen, adding talents and class skills for each race.

17. Monster type display has been added. Convenient capture after synthesis view.

18. Some known bugs.



Due to personal development and change momentum is too large. Test volume may be insufficient, if you encounter a bug, please temporarily shut down the game and re-enter.  welcome feedback bug at any time. After the update, I will continue to test and receive feedback. Your valuable comments and suggestions are welcome.

In addition, it is suggested to open a new file to play.

notes.title: 2021.5.1 updates
notes.content:
1.Modify the main gameplay to reduce frequent repetition. Change route selection to circling.

2.During the movement of the player, random events are added. The specific gameplay is divided into three random element types, and different benefits can be obtained according to different combinations of the three elements. The probability of each element appearing is related to the team's elemental damage and elemental defense, which can be paired with battle souls and equipments to increase the income of a resource.

3.When creating a new save, you can select the difficulty (currently there are three modes: easy, normal, and hard), select the start race, and select two initial runes.

4.Added game speed button that can change the game to 1x, 2x and 4x speed.

5.Added a pause button to pause viewing of monster data and other actions.（shortcut key：space）

6.Modified some rune effects. Specific view of the game Heirloom shop interface.

7.In order to increase the gameplay, the inheritances of Masters were previously too high. They are now reduced to 1% per 100 reputation points. Rune can  increased this effects.

8.The shop button is placed on the main screen. Each time you pass a level (circle), you can refresh the shop items. The store items are sold in health bottles and stamina bottles, and can be used in key battles.

9.Each career adds a team effects. When a new career is activited。 it will  provide a effect to the team even if the career is not deployed.

10. the soul skills in battle, when all the soul skills are finished, the soul skills will be restet. After being reset, each skill will cost 5% of the owner's hp.
11.At the start of the battle, the initial number of soul skills is team heroes num (3 heroes start with 3 soul skills). Each time when full chargeing, the release of the soul skills   number is team heroes num
12.fix some bugs。


notes：
1.This is a big change, if the old file does not have too much feelings, it is suggested to open a new file。
 If necessary, you can backup of the old saves, which can be used when reporting bugs (save location:  save directory under the game directory)

2.If you encounter any problem with old files or any bug in the game, Please send feedback through the community or email（hpkjxyx@qq.com）. I will deal with it quickly after I see it

notes.title: 3.26 updates
notes.content:
Retreat option is added in the main interface. Retreat will keep the current level, reputation, equipment and fighting spirit of the brave, 60% of money and soul power, and lose 15 points of maximum physical ability

Resurrection option is added in the main interface. You can consume gold coins and soul energy to resurrect your teammates at any time

New currency and Hero Medal have been added. You can get reward after completing reward task every time

At the beginning of the new generation, the legacy store has been added to exchange various legacy equipment, runes and war spirits

At the beginning of the new generation, reward task has been added, and Hero Medal can be exchanged after completing the specified conditions

Cancel the random Rune when customs clearance, change the extra gold, soul power, equipment, war spirit and Hero Medal

The strengthened attributes of the brave are included in the initial attributes, which can be inherited after reaching the master

Before entering a new level or a new generation, the cancel option has been added. You can prepare the team, resurrect the hero and enter the next level by yourself. You can even retreat to practice

The monster capture system has been added to capture monsters and join our camp. Monsters can be inherited from generation to generation. The same monster combination can enhance the monster attribute. Note: the maximum number of monsters and brave players is 6

The store interface in the dungeon can open the team interface for preparation

Fixed some known bugs

Due to many changes, it is recommended to open a new archive experience game. If there are problems with the old archive game, please contact me by   email(hpkjxyx@qq.com) or bbs to solve them
